mapper.sql: order_item . id , order_item.order_id, order_item.spu_id, order_item.sku_id, order_item.spu_name, order_item.pic_url, order_item.sales_price, order_item.buy_quantity, order_item.total_price, order_item.freight_price, order_item.coupon_price, order_item.payment_price, order_item.create_time, order_item.update_time, order_item.del_flag, order_item.specs_info, order_item.`status`
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM order_item AS order_item WHERE order_item.`id` = #{id}

SELECT order_item.sku_id AS skuId, order_item.spu_id AS spuId, MAX(order_item.spu_name) AS spuName, MAX(order_item.specs_info) AS specsInfo, MAX(order_item.pic_url) AS picUrl, SUM(order_item.buy_quantity) AS totalQuantity, COUNT(DISTINCT order_item.order_id) AS orderCount, MAX(order_info.create_time) AS lastPurchaseTime FROM order_item AS order_item INNER JOIN order_info AS order_info ON order_info.id = order_item.order_id AND order_info.tenant_id = order_item.tenant_id AND order_info.del_flag = '0' AND order_info.user_id = #{userId} AND order_info.status IN ('2', '3', '4') AND order_info.create_time >= #{startTime} WHERE order_item.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND order_item.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY order_item.sku_id, order_item.spu_id ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
